FIGURE 6 (a) Schematic of the integrated platform. A trained state perception module is implemented based on the real-time cycling data from every 3 cycles, serving as an intelligent in situ monitor to identify the state of the operating battery, including stable, transitional, and decay states. Reinforcement learning (RL) further enables intelligent cycling by adaptively optimizing fast charging strategies for solid-state batteries across cycles based on the battery state. An electrochemical test station is used to cycle actual batteries controlled by the above AI workstation. (b) Engineering- oriented workflow showing the real-time communication, data, and control loop. The AI workstation enables bidirectional communication with the tester hardware. Every 3-cycle data is continuously collected to evaluate the battery state, which is then used to adaptively control the charging strategy
